puerta.texto: An old wooden classroom door: the metal latch clicks and the hinges creak briefly as the door swings open. Close-up, dry room, no music, no voices.

puerta-cerrada.texto: Someone tries to open a locked wooden door: the metal doorknob rattles three times and does not turn. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.

clac.texto: A single firm click of a metal latch on an old machine being unlocked. Very short, close-up, dry, no music.

teclas.texto: Three keys pressed on an old mechanical cash register, then a small bright bell ding. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.

registradora.texto: A vintage cash register bell rings and the metal cash drawer slides open with a clunk. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.

imprenta.texto: A small hand label printer stamps a label: one quick mechanical press and thump. Close-up, dry, no music.

incubadora.texto: A small laboratory incubator door unlatches and opens with a soft hiss of warm air, then a gentle electronic chime. Close-up, no music.

casilleros.texto: Two metal school lockers swing open one after the other with clanky metallic bangs. Close-up, indoor, no music, no voices.

recoger.texto: Picking up a small object from a wooden desk: a quick soft rustle and tap. Very short, close-up, no music.

libro.texto: A hardcover book placed on a metal library cart: a soft dull paper thud. Very short, close-up, no music.

ficha.texto: A small plastic token drops into a plastic box: a short light click and rattle. Very short, close-up, no music.

interfono.texto: An old school intercom: a short electric buzz followed by a speaker click. Close-up, no music, no voices.

palanca.texto: A heavy metal lever pulled down on an old machine: a ratcheting clunk. Close-up, dry, no music.

campana.texto: A single small brass desk bell rings once and fades out slowly. Close-up, dry, no music.

polea.texto: A rope runs quickly through a squeaky metal pulley and a small weight lands with a thud. Close-up, indoor, no music.

manija.texto: A metal crank handle on a box is turned: six quick ratchet clicks. Close-up, dry, no music.

fichas.texto: Many small plastic tokens tumble and rattle inside a rotating plastic drum. Close-up, dry, no music.

mano.texto: A small robotic arm moves down and back up: a servo motor whirs and changes pitch. Close-up, no music.

caja-fuerte.texto: A small metal safe opens: two heavy bolt clacks and the door hinge creaks. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
